fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description:
Default - a grid of cards.
Carousel - auto-rotates; recommended: 6 to 12 cards.
Timeline - 6 to 10 cards.
Pillars - up to 6 cards, JPG or PNG images only.
Roller - 3 to 6 cards, one per scroll step.
Rail - a horizontally scrolling row of fixed-width cards, any number.
Features - cards that open their details in a pop-up, with a Next button to the next card.
  Image cards (Technology, Safety), any number, in a sideways-scrolling row: the picture fills the card; its title shows on one line, its short line on two; the rest shows in the pop-up (title 2 lines, text 6 lines on phones, 8 on desktop).
  Stat tiles (Performance), 1 or more: 1 to 4 tiles fill the row; with 5 or more, 4 show at a time (pages of 4, 2 x 2, on phones) and arrows move to the rest. Value in bold, up to 16 characters (e.g. 590 Nm); label up to 2 lines; in the pop-up, title up to 3 lines and description up to 250 characters. The section's figure: up to 4 digits and a 4-letter unit (e.g. 359 PS).
  Longer texts end in … on the page (Universal Editor shows them whole). Card text order: see the card's Text field.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Pillars: 1. Label 2. Heading 3. Description, opening words in bold. Timeline: 1. Title as a heading, 2. Description 3. Location in italics. Roller: 1. Title as a heading 2. Description. Carousel in a Light section: 1. Label 2. Title as a heading 3. Description 4. Link. Features: 1. Title as a heading (image card, one line), or in bold for a stat tile (up to 16 characters, e.g. 590 Nm) 2. Short line (two lines) 3. and on: the detail, shown with the image when the card is opened; a heading first is the detail title (up to 3 lines on a stat tile), and a stat tile shows up to 250 characters of the rest. Longer texts end in … on the page.
